availability_audit: Every member's source map precedes Route 119 in book play order. Mudkip: Mauville Game Corner 500 coins (gate 30) -> Marshtomp -> Swampert (gate 36); Swampertite stone-window 14. Gible: Route 111 land (gate 30) -> Gabite -> Garchomp (gate 48). Drilbur: Rusturf Tunnel land (gate 20) -> Excadrill (gate 36). Abra: Granite Cave 1F land (gate 20) -> Kadabra -> Linking Cord Alakazam (gate 20). Azurill: Route 104 land (gate 14) -> Marill -> Azumarill (gate 20). Foongus: Petalburg Woods land (gate 14) -> Amoonguss (gate 42). No legendaries, mythicals, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species. Items from the free Center held-item catalogue / preparation system.
plan: Rebuilt after attempt 1 lost 6-3. Attempt 1's party was three Flying types (Mega Charizard Y, Togekiss, Dragonite) into a rival holding Manectric's Thunderbolt and Blaziken's Rock Slide, and my own Drought boosted Camerupt's Heat Wave by 1.5x - a party-level mistake, not a difficulty verdict. v2 answers the actual team: three Electric-immune Ground types blank Manectric entirely, Mega Swampert is 3x into Camerupt through Solid Rock and resists Blaziken's Fire, Amoonguss is Grass so Spore cannot touch it and Excadrill's Lum Berry eats the one Spore that matters, Alakazam's Psychic is 2x into both Fighting types, and Excadrill's Iron Head is 2x into Mimikyu once Disguise breaks. Nothing on this party is weak to Rock Slide or Brave Bird.
